entries.back_en: "I know you — my mom says you're that fela that's living together with Mami! What does 'living together for real' mean, by the way?"
"Hey! You're that fela that Mami's taking care of, right?"
"Who are you? Where do you come from? We're not into welcoming strangers around here..."
"Mami... What're you doing with that thing..."
"Oh no... I didn't want the landlord to find out about you..."
"Well... It'll be fine, as long as we keep pretending you're my cousin... You should worry more about yourself than me! Your wound hasn't fully healed! You shouldn't even be walking around!"
"Calling you my cousin was the first thing that came to mind... But you really are..."
"Many were the nations of the world then, and they made terrible war upon each other."
"However, even as he dreamed, glimpsed a terrible truth."
"Even being complete, he could not satisfy all the people's desires!"
"Indeed. And why not? Because people are..."
"I know you! You're Mami's guy! I mean cousin, right!?"
"What is this!? I sense a presence... It's as if it were one of the Eternal..."
"I judge it not wise that thou... That we continue in this... relationship."
"Ryong..."
"Don't let what the landlord said bother you... All the folks in the village are grateful for what you did... And so am I..."
"It seems I must fight my way out... No... Maybe I can still escape unnoticed by those soldiers..."
"What is this? What importance has this village to me? Why do I hesitate? My path is clear — Defeat the soldiers and head to Chedo... And yet..."
"So this is where you've been hiding him, eh?"
"H-hiding!? We didn't know he was wanted!"
"I... I told everyone in the village to get whatever could be used as a weapon... We'll help you capture him, all right? Heh heh..."
"Mami!?" "Thou wouldst do such a thing?"
"Thou wouldst do such a thing?"
"Thou wouldst protect me — hinder their attempts to imprison me? Thou art taking a great risk. As for what thy fellows will think of thee?"
entries.note: 'tomando um risco' should be 'correndo um risco'.

entries.back_en: "And I thought, maybe if you hid out here, with me... You might be able to live a normal life... With me..."
"I know it's silly — it can't be... But I wished so hard it would be!"
"Forgive me... I never should have kept you here...!"
"You were hiding [name], weren't you? Did you... live with him?"
"Take her back to Astana. We can use her in the Carronade."
"Did you feel that? It was like a tremor..."
"If you're well enough to walk around, why aren't you working like everyone else? Everyone around here has to earn their keep, you know."
"Sigh."
